incident_text: Portfolio pages and the assistant's balance answers are very slow since about 15:10.

truth.description: A cache stampede on redis-cache after a burst of hot-key TTL expiry: the hit ratio collapsed, load fell on postgres, and portfolio-svc slowed.

logs.msg: ttl expiry burst: {evicted_keys} hot keys expired within one second
holdings cache miss rate high: hit_ratio {hit_ratio}, falling back to postgres
slow query: holdings lookup took {latency_ms}ms, {pool_waiting} clients waiting

trap: the metrics tool times out on the first two calls and returns partial data on the next two
